snippet.title: StarDrone | gameplay trailer (2011)
snippet.description:
from the press release
Beatshapers Limited and TastyPlay.com announced that StarDrone is coming to PlayStation 3 .

StarDrone is a high-speed action thriller with a mix of arcade action, pinball, breakout, physics and collect-the-objects. It is created for PlayStation Move motion controller and supports HDTV and stereoscopic 3D. The game features over 50 levels of unparalleled gaming experience and extraordinary replay value.

Cause your attackers to crash with rapid speed while collecting gems and power-up enhancements. Overcome perilous hazards and elude zillions of enemies in an effort to complete each stage with a record score. With simple gesture controls and unique, intuitive game play mechanics, StarDrone is friendly to beginners, at the same time challenging enough to bring you back for more and more.

About Beatshapers 

Beatshapers Limited is a video game developer and digital publisher located in Ukraine. The studio is licensed to develop on all gaming consoles and published it's first PlayStation Minis game, BreakQuest, on the PlayStation  Network in 2009. During spring and summer 2010, Beatshapers released two minis in Europe and North America: NormalTanks and Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter and currently working on two more unannounced minis. Key members of the company worked on IL-2 Sturmovik: Birds of Prey (PSP), Rhythm of War (PSP, IGF Mobile 2009 Finalist) and MelodyBloxx (PSP, IGF Mobile 2010 Honorable Mention / Audio Achievement). For more information, please visit http://www.beatshapers.com or follow us on Twitter @Beatshapers

About TastyPlay.com:

TastyPlay.com is an online gaming portal operated by Orb Games Limited, with a focus on delivering fun free games to its visitors. In 2010 Orb Games/TastyPlay started to develop and publish games for home consoles and mobile devices, such as Sony PlayStation 3, Sony PlayStation Portable, iOS and Android handhelds. The first batch of titles to be released includes TastyPlay's smash-hits Kamikaze Race and Homeboy Heroes, as well as new IP Stardrone. 

For more information, please visit http://www.tastyplay.com or follow us on Twitter @tastyplay
